 Coverage by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias Updated October 20, 2026, 4:54 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 4:54 PM ET 4:53 PM ET an hour ago End of the game:
 Manchester City thrashed AEK Athens 5-1 on Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League. It was a masterclass from the Citizens at home.

 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 75' 4:33 PM ET an hour ago The manager wants fresh legs on the pitch and orders a substitution. Rayan Ait-Nouri (Manchester City) comes on for Enzo Fernández. In the next two plays, AEK had chances to narrow the deficit: Aboubakary Koita fires a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender blocks it, averting the danger. The goalkeeper stretches to save a dangerous effort from Oleksandr Zubkov aimed toward the left post.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 70' 4:28 PM ET an hour ago Zini plays a ball into open space for Oleksandr Zubkov (AEK) to collect. He tests the goalkeeper from distance, but his shot goes wide of the left post. Maresca’s side managed to strike just when the Greeks were playing their best.

 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias

 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 52' 4:11 PM ET an hour ago Stavro Pilo!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAL, GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAL, GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAL for AEK Athens. We’ve got a game on our hands in Manchester! A great play by the Greeks to narrow the deficit.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 50' 4:09 PM ET an hour ago Enzo Fernández capitalizes on a good pass and fires a shot at goal from mid-range, but a defender blocks it. Manchester City get an opportunity from a corner kick. This is the first real threat of the second half.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 46' 4:06 PM ET 2 hours ago The break has ended, and the players have taken to the pitch. The second half begins. Marko Nikolic decides to make two substitutions: Razvan Marin (AEK) is replaced by Aboubakary Koita, and Barnabas Varga is replaced by Zini.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias

 With goals from Anderson and Foden, Manchester City lead 2-0 against AEK Athens. That brings us to halftime, folks.

 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 40' 3:41 PM ET 2 hours ago FIVE MINUTES REMAIN IN THE FIRST HALF: A delivery into the box finds Rayan Cherki (Manchester City), who is unmarked. He fires a precise shot toward the bottom-left corner, but Alberto Brignoli makes a brilliant save.

 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 30' 3:32 PM ET 2 hours ago In a brilliant individual effort, Rayan Cherki drives into the box and pulls the trigger. His shot is blocked by one of the defenders. Manchester City will take a corner kick. After 30 minutes, the home side continues to keep the pressure on their opponents.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 25' 3:28 PM ET 2 hours ago Allan Elias (Manchester City) displays his incredible technique as he finds himself one-on-one with the goal, only to send the ball against the crossbar. A great play, but the finish lacked a bit of luck. AEK had a good spell, but they’ve since faded; it’s a shame that they’re now focused on avoiding a rout rather than trying to create anything themselves.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 20' 3:23 PM ET 2 hours ago Phil Foden sends a low pass into the box, but the opposing defense manages to clear the ball. It goes out for a corner—a chance for Manchester City to threaten the opposition's goal. The Citizens have found their rhythm and are now closing in on a second goal.

 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 10' 3:13 PM ET 2 hours ago The first 10 minutes of the match show that the visitors didn’t come here to sit back, but rather to take the initiative. Manchester City has been very imprecise, and it shows. The Greeks are more aggressive, and their tactical approach is clear.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 7' 3:08 PM ET 3 hours ago A loose ball falls to Kervin Arriaga (AEK), who fires a shot toward goal from long range. It sails well over the crossbar—another warning sign for Manchester City, who have started the match looking very sluggish.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 5' 3:05 PM ET 3 hours ago Razvan Marin receives a good pass and fires a dangerous shot from just outside the box, but his effort is blocked by a defender. The visitors have started by pressing Manchester City as they try to play out from the back. A promising attack!

 FRIENDS, welcome to Tuesday’s action in the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League. We are set for the clash between Manchester City and AEK Athens. The Citizens will be without Haaland from the start due to injury. Furthermore, the club is closely monitoring potential sanctions related to Financial Fair Play.

 We'll soon be sharing the starting lineups for the Manchester City vs AEK match live, along with the latest information from Etihad Stadium. Don't miss a single detail of the live match update and VAVEL's commentary.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 2:50 PM ET 3 hours ago Best international result: Their greatest historical achievement was reaching the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup (now the UEFA Europa League) in the 1977–78 season, where they were eliminated by Juventus after having knocked out teams such as Dynamo Moscow, Derby County, QPR, and Red Star.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 2:45 PM ET 3 hours ago According to an exclusive report from the Daily Mail, citing sources close to the case, Manchester City could face an unprecedented sanction for breaching the Premier League’s financial regulations. The most severe potential punishment includes a heavy points deduction—which would relegate the team directly to the Championship—alongside a massive financial penalty. This sanction would take effect immediately during the current season, and the possibility of further points deductions for the following campaign has not been ruled out, which would hinder any quick return to the top flight.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 2:44 PM ET 3 hours ago How to watch Manchester City vs AEK Live Stream on TV and Online?
 If you want to watch the Manchester City vs AEK match live on television, your option is Fox Sports.
 If you want to watch it live via streaming: fuboTV.
 If you want to watch it online, VAVEL is your best bet.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 2:40 PM ET 3 hours ago In the pre-match press conference, Maresca revealed that the availability of top scorer Erling Haaland remains in doubt following a very busy period. "[Erling Haaland] might be available. We’ll see," Maresca explained. "He was doing quite well yesterday—better, in fact—so we’ll see how he is today."
 "The only player who will be sidelined for likely eight weeks is Antoine [Semenyo]."
 Regarding the importance of the match, the Italian manager added: "Tomorrow’s game is very important... We lost the last one, so we need to win matches. We’re going to try to win, fielding the best players we have available right now."
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 2:36 PM ET 3 hours ago Manchester City’s legal situation has reached a critical juncture following a verdict from an independent Premier League commission, which found the club guilty of 114 out of 115 financial charges brought against it. The infractions—ranging from the failure to provide accurate financial information to the concealment of payments made to players and coaching staff between 2009 and 2018—expose the club to an unprecedented array of potential penalties. These include multi-million-pound fines, a massive points deduction, and even the very real threat of relegation or the stripping of titles. Although the Manchester-based club maintains its innocence and is preparing to appeal the decision, the football world waits in anticipation for the final sanction, which will determine the club’s sporting and financial future at the pinnacle of European football.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 2:30 PM ET 3 hours ago Throughout their history in UEFA competitions, Manchester City have maintained an impeccable record against Greek opponents, having won every match played within regulation time. Their first official encounter took place in the round of 32 of the 2010–11 Europa League, where they eliminated Aris Thessaloniki following a 0–0 draw away from home and a 3–0 victory in England. Subsequently, during the group stage of the 2020–21 Champions League, the side managed by Pep Guardiola faced Olympiacos, securing wins both at the Etihad Stadium (3–0) and in Greece (0–1). In total, the 'Citizens' have recorded 3 wins and 1 draw—remaining undefeated against Greek clubs in European tournaments—while scoring 7 goals and keeping a clean sheet in all four matches.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 2:20 PM ET 3 hours ago AEK Athens has a historically poor record against English clubs in UEFA competitions, having recorded 3 wins and 11 losses in 14 official encounters, with no draws to date. Their golden era against British opposition occurred during the 1976/77 UEFA Cup, when they achieved an unforgettable feat by eliminating both Derby County and Queens Park Rangers—overturning a 3-0 deficit in the second leg against the latter—to reach the tournament's semi-finals. Although they subsequently endured difficult setbacks and long winless streaks against opponents such as Liverpool, Nottingham Forest, Everton, and Leicester City, the Greek side managed another surprise on the international stage in September 2023, defeating Brighton & Hove Albion 2-3 away from home in the UEFA Europa League—marking their first and only victory on English soil.
 Updates by Juan Sebastian Rodriguez Arias
 2:16 PM ET 3 hours ago Manchester City and AEK have never faced each other; there is no advantage for either side—zero wins for each team in zero matches played. This marks their first-ever encounter in the Champions League.
